summary: "...To Be Loved" is the first single from Papa Roach's fourth album, "The Paramour Sessions", and the band's eighth released single overall. The song returns somewhat to the band's early style with a rapping introduction that shifts into fast screaming, while most of the track is sung, with Jacoby handling the verses and choruses. It follows the hard rock sound of the previous album, and it was released to radio, digital download, UK vinyl and CD formats in 2006. The song also served as the official theme for WWE Raw and charted on two rock chart lists.
one_line: Papa Roach's 2006 single "...To Be Loved" from The Paramour Sessions, which became WWE Raw's theme song.
key_facts: "...To Be Loved" is the first single from Papa Roach's fourth album, "The Paramour Sessions".
The song is the eighth released single in Papa Roach's total singles output.
The song starts with a rapping introduction that goes into fast screaming, differing from the band's usual early rapping.
Jacoby sings in the verses and choruses, with most of the song being singing.
The song follows the band's hard rock sound of their previous album.
The song hit American radio stations on August 7, 2006.
The song was played in full on Kerrang! Radio in the United Kingdom on August 1, 2006.
The radio edit version became available to download via the iTunes Store and Walmart Downloads store.
On September 18, the single became available in UK stores as a 7" vinyl picture disc with a complimentary Papa Roach sticker.
The CD was released on October 11, 2006.
The song was the official theme song for "WWE Raw" on the USA Network from October 9, 2006 to November 9, 2009.
The song rose to #8 on the "Mainstream Rock Tracks" chart.
The song rose to #14 on the "Modern Rock Tracks" chart.
The song was played during the theatrical trailer of the 2008 film Never Back Down.
